lines: "Somebody told me the world's got a smallest size. You can't cut past it. Like a grain."
"And a grain's a pixel. That's a screen, mate."
"Or it's just how matter is. You found the bottom of a thing and decided it was a floor somebody laid. Water has a smallest drop too. Nobody says the ocean's a picture of an ocean."
"Everything feels different at this hour. Go to bed."
